settings.hero_desc: A monumental robotic hand sculpture cradling a product aloft - here a giant lipstick - built at human-plus scale for retail, events and brand activations. A showstopping installation that stops people in their tracks.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your product, scale, finish and branding
settings.s1_body: When a brand wants to make an unforgettable impression, we build at scale. This giant robotic hand presents a product to the sky - sculpted with articulated fingers and a polished finish, built large enough to dominate a mall atrium, event space or store front. Tell us your product and we'll build the installation that puts it centre stage.
settings.case_body: Built as a brand activation for letoil, this giant robotic hand presented the product at monumental scale - a head-turning centrepiece that drew crowds, photos and social posts wherever it stood.
settings.case_quote: It stopped everyone in their tracks. The photos alone gave us reach we never expected.
settings.prov_p: In a crowded space, size wins. A monumental sculpture turns a product into a landmark - and a brand moment people stop, stare and share.
